specs.value: Twinstar 450E (E series Vr. IV), 18 inch class
Fixed legs sized for specific rimless tanks (the adjustable-leg version is a different model)

variants.name: 450EA IV (adjustable legs, with added orange LEDs; a separate sub-line)

fits.fact: The 450E IV has fixed legs that only suit certain rimless tanks with glass up to 5 mm thick. Buyers who need adjustable legs are pointed to another version.
The E-line 450 models are aimed at planted freshwater tanks. The maker recommends a tank width of up to about 50 cm for the 450E.
The sibling 450EA IV is listed for 45-60 cm tanks with glass up to 6 mm. It is meant for open-top tanks and is not recommended inside a hood or lid.
The 450E V is listed as fitting UNS 45U, 45T, 45C, 45S and 50C tanks.

usage.fact: The inline controller on the IV-generation E line has on/off, sunrise/sunset, a 7-step dimmer and a timer.
The fixture is not waterproof. The retailer says to keep at least about 6 inches between the light and the water and to run it on an open top.
The power supply and brackets come in the box. Some EU stock ships with an EU plug, so you may need an adapter.

issues.fact: Retailers list conflicting specs for '450E IV', and the 450E and 450EA IV are often mixed up. The E is listed at 28 W and 1,850 lm, while the EA is listed at 30 W and 1,500 lm with added orange LEDs, so check the exact model code.
Version IV is being replaced by the E-line V, which adds a 6-colour spectrum and Bluetooth app control. Several IV listings abroad are out of stock or have stale prices.
A Vietnamese hobby writer called Twinstar an early, expensive, premium RGB light. The same writer rated the ADA Solar RGB as brighter than Twinstar.
No Vietnamese shop website listed the 450E IV with a price. Vua Aqua's Twinstar page shows only ES 60/90 models, priced as 'Liên hệ' (contact for price).

alternatives.why: This is the direct successor. It is brighter (2,100 lm), has a 6-colour spectrum and Bluetooth app control, and is easier to find now that IV is being phased out.
It is widely sold in Vietnam for about 2.02 million VND, rated 49 W and 3,600 lm for 45-60 cm tanks. That is far more output than the 450E IV, and you can get local support.
It is a cheaper Twinstar RGB-W light sold in Vietnam for about 1.39 million VND, with a soft-start feature and a rated life of about 30,000 h.
